Subject: Vendor onboarding & PO match requirements for Redwood

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — procurement and AP are ready to start vendor registration so we can begin routing POs to Redwood. Before we open the vendor record in our portal we need a short packet from your side and a couple of confirmations about PO/invoice matching rules.

Could you confirm the following and attach any supporting docs: 
- Legal entity name and VAT/tax IDs we should use for the vendor record
- Remit-to bank details (IBAN + BIC) and whether you support EUR payouts to EU accounts
- Exact invoice header you expect (billing address / invoice recipient)
- PO matching rules: do you require the PO number on line-level or header-level to pass 3-way match? Do you accept PO-less invoices in any cases?
- Any specific invoice PDF filename conventions or UBL fields you need to retain

Procurement will also need your completed vendor form (attached PDF) and a copy of your VAT certificate if you have one registered in the EU. Once we have these items we can provision a vendor ID and run a single PO acceptance test.

Thanks — aiming to have the vendor Ready status by Oct 20.

Best,
Elena Moreno
Senior Buyer — Strategic Accounts
Stratacorp S.A.
